title: This could change the way we MAKE THINGS
excerpt:
In this video, we take a deep dive into PCB design using a new AI-powered tool called Flux. You'll see the complete end-to-end process of creating a breakout board for the ICM-42670-P, a 6-axis inertial measurement unit (IMU) from TDK.
Flux helps make PCB design more accessible to makers, engineers, and enthusiasts who may have found traditional tools intimidating or overly complex.
This was a fun project to work on—I hope you enjoy the video!
